triggers.corex_task_occurrences_occurrence_key_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_occurrences_occurrence_key_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_occurrences BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.occurrence_key) = 64 AND NEW.occurrence_key NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid occurrence_key') END; END
triggers.corex_task_occurrences_revision_fk: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_occurrences_revision_fk BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_occurrences BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM corex_task_series WHERE series_key = NEW.series_key AND immutable_revision = NEW.immutable_revision) THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid occurrence revision') END; END
triggers.corex_task_occurrences_state_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_occurrences_state_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_occurrences BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.state IN ('pending','committed','cancelled','retired','unknown') THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid state') END; END

triggers.corex_task_series_context_hash_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_context_hash_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.context_hash) = 64 AND NEW.context_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid context_hash') END; END
triggers.corex_task_series_definition_hash_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_definition_hash_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.definition_hash) = 64 AND NEW.definition_hash NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid definition_hash') END; END
triggers.corex_task_series_restore_epoch_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_restore_epoch_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.restore_epoch) = 64 AND NEW.restore_epoch NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid restore_epoch') END; END

triggers.corex_task_series_state_generation_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_state_generation_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series_state BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.generation) <= 20 AND NEW.generation NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*' AND NEW.generation <= '18446744073709551615' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid generation') END; END
triggers.corex_task_series_state_restore_epoch_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_state_restore_epoch_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series_state BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN length(NEW.restore_epoch) = 64 AND NEW.restore_epoch NOT GLOB '*[^a-f0-9]*' THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid restore_epoch') END; END
triggers.corex_task_series_state_retired_ck: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_state_retired_ck BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series_state BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.retired IN (0, 1) THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid retired') END; END
triggers.corex_task_series_state_revision_fk: CREATE TRIGGER corex_task_series_state_revision_fk BEFORE INSERT ON corex_task_series_state BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM corex_task_series WHERE series_key = NEW.series_key AND immutable_revision = NEW.active_revision) THEN 0 ELSE RAISE(ABORT, 'invalid active revision') END; END
